shloka_text: जिते महेन्द्रे ऽतिबले रावणस्य सुतेन वै । प्रजापतिं पुरस्कृत्य ययुर्लङ्कां सुरास्तदा ।। 7.30.1 ।।
transliteration: jite mahendre 'tibale rāvaṇasya sutena vai | prajāpatiṃ puraskṛtya yayurlaṅkāṃ surāstadā || 7.30.1 ||
translation: जिते when conquered, महेन्द्रे Mahendra, अतिबले exceedingly powerful, रावणस्य of Ravana, सुतेन by the son, वै indeed, प्रजापतिं Prajapati, पुरस्कृत्य having placed in front, ययुः went, लङ्कां to Lanka, सुराः the gods, तदा then.
explanation: When the exceedingly powerful Mahendra was indeed conquered by Ravana's son, the gods then went to Lanka, making Prajapati their leader.
comments: Brahma comes to Lanka to ransom Indra and names Ravana's son Indrajit, the conqueror of Indra -- denied outright immortality, Indrajit is granted that, whenever he first worships fire, a sun-chariot shall bear him invincible into battle -- Indra is freed, and Brahma reveals that his captivity was the fruit of his violation of Ahalya, bidding him regain heaven by a Vaishnava sacrifice -- thus, says Agastya, was even Indra conquered.

shloka_text: तत्र रावणमासाद्य पुत्रभ्रातृभिरावृतम् । अब्रवीद्गगने तिष्ठन्सामपूर्वं प्रजापतिः ।। 7.30.2 ।।
transliteration: tatra rāvaṇamāsādya putrabhrātṛbhirāvṛtam | abravīdgagane tiṣṭhansāmapūrvaṃ prajāpatiḥ || 7.30.2 ||
translation: तत्र there, रावणम् Ravana, आसाद्य having approached, पुत्रभ्रातृभिः by sons and brothers, आवृतम् surrounded, अब्रवीत् spoke, गगने in the sky, तिष्ठन् standing, सामपूर्वं with gentle words first, प्रजापतिः Prajapati.
explanation: There, Prajapati, standing in the sky, approached Ravana who was surrounded by his sons and brothers, and spoke to him first with gentle words.

shloka_text: वत्स रावण तुष्टो ऽस्मि पुत्रस्य तव संयुगे । अहो ऽस्य विक्रमौदार्यं तव तुल्यो ऽधिको ऽपि वा ।। 7.30.3 ।।
transliteration: vatsa rāvaṇa tuṣṭo 'smi putrasya tava saṃyuge | aho 'sya vikramaudāryaṃ tava tulyo 'dhiko 'pi vā || 7.30.3 ||
translation: वत्स dear son, रावण Ravana, तुष्टः अस्मि I am pleased, पुत्रस्य with the son, तव your, संयुगे in battle, अहो oh!, अस्य his, विक्रमौदार्यं valor and magnanimity, तव your, तुल्यः equal, अधिकः superior, अपि वा or even.
explanation: Prajapati said, "Dear son Ravana, I am pleased with your son's performance in battle; oh, his valor and magnanimity are equal to yours, or perhaps even superior!"

shloka_text: जितं हि भवता सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं स्वेन तेजसा । कृता प्रतिज्ञा सफला प्रीतो ऽस्मि स्वसुतेन वै ।। 7.30.4 ।।
transliteration: jitaṃ hi bhavatā sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ svena tejasā | kṛtā pratijñā saphalā prīto 'smi svasutena vai || 7.30.4 ||
translation: जितं conquered, हि indeed, भवता by you, सर्वं all, त्रैलोक्यं the three worlds, स्वेन by your own, तेजसा prowess, कृता made, प्रतिज्ञा vow, सफला fruitful, प्रीतः अस्मि I am pleased, स्वसुतेन by your own son, वै indeed.
explanation: Indeed, all three worlds have been conquered by your own prowess, and your vow has been made fruitful; I am truly pleased by your own son.

shloka_text: अयं च पुत्रो ऽतिबलस्तव रावण वीर्यवान् । जगतीन्द्रजिदित्येव परिख्यातो भविष्यति ।। 7.30.5 ।।
transliteration: ayaṃ ca putro 'tibalastava rāvaṇa vīryavān | jagatīndrajidityeva parikhyāto bhaviṣyati || 7.30.5 ||
translation: अयं this, च and, पुत्रो son, अतिबलः exceedingly strong, तव your, रावण O Ravana, वीर्यवान् valorous, जगतीन्द्रजित् Indrajit in the world, इति thus, एव indeed, परिख्यातः renowned, भविष्यति will be
explanation: This exceedingly strong and valorous son of yours, O Ravana, will indeed be renowned in the world as Indrajit.

shloka_text: बलवान्दुर्जयश्चैव भविष्यत्येव राक्षसः । यं समाश्रित्य ते राजन्स्थापितास्त्रिदशा वशे ।। 7.30.6 ।।
transliteration: balavāndurjayaścaiva bhaviṣyatyeva rākṣasaḥ | yaṃ samāśritya te rājansthāpitāstridaśā vaśe || 7.30.6 ||
translation: बलवान् powerful, दुर्जयः unconquerable, च and, एव indeed, भविष्यति will be, एव indeed, राक्षसः demon, यं whom, समाश्रित्य having relied upon, ते by you, राजन् O King, स्थापिताः placed, त्रिदशाः the gods, वशे under control
explanation: This demon will indeed be powerful and unconquerable, O King, and it is by relying on him that you have kept the gods under your control.

shloka_text: तन्मुच्यतां महाबाहो महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः । किञ्चास्य मोक्षणार्थाय प्रयच्छन्तु दिवौकसः ।। 7.30.7 ।।
transliteration: tanmucyatāṃ mahābāho mahendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ | kiñcāsya mokṣaṇārthāya prayacchantu divaukasaḥ || 7.30.7 ||
translation: तत् therefore, मुच्यतां let him be released, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, महेन्द्रः the great Indra, पाकशासनः the slayer of Paka, किञ्च and also, अस्य his, मोक्षणार्थाय for the sake of release, प्रयच्छन्तु let them give, दिवौकसः the dwellers of heaven
explanation: Therefore, O mighty-armed one, let the great Indra, the slayer of Paka, be released, and let the gods also offer something for his liberation.

shloka_text: अथाब्रवीन्महातेजा इन्द्रजित्समितिञ्जयः । अमरत्वमहं देव वृणे यद्येष मुच्यते ।। 7.30.8 ।।
transliteration: athābravīnmahātejā indrajitsamitiñjayaḥ | amaratvamahaṃ deva vṛṇe yadyeṣa mucyate || 7.30.8 ||
translation: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent, इन्द्रजित् Indrajit, समितिञ्जयः conqueror in battle, अमरत्वम् immortality, अहं I, देव O god, वृणे choose, यदि if, एषः this one, मुच्यते is released
explanation: Then, the greatly effulgent Indrajit, the conqueror in battle, spoke, saying, "O god, I choose immortality if this one (Indra) is released."

shloka_text: चतुष्पदां खेचराणामन्येषां वा महौजसाम् । वृक्षगुल्मक्षुपलतातृणोपलमहीभृताम् ।। 7.30.9 ।।
transliteration: catuṣpadāṃ khecarāṇāmanyeṣāṃ vā mahaujasām | vṛkṣagulmakṣupalatātṛṇopalamahībhṛtām || 7.30.9 ||
translation: चतुष्पदां of quadrupeds, खेचराणां of sky-dwellers, अन्येषां of others, वा or, महौजसां of greatly powerful ones, वृक्षगुल्मक्षुपलतातृणोपलमहीभृताम् of trees, bushes, shrubs, creepers, grasses, stones, and mountains
explanation: This refers to various categories of beings and objects, including quadrupeds, sky-dwellers, other greatly powerful entities, and also trees, bushes, shrubs, creepers, grasses, stones, and mountains.

shloka_text: सर्वे ऽपि जन्तवो ऽन्योन्यं भेतव्ये सति बिभ्यति । अतो ऽत्र लोके सर्वेषां सर्वस्माच्च भवेद्भयम् ।। 7.30.10 ।।
transliteration: sarve 'pi jantavo 'nyonyaṃ bhetavye sati bibhyati | ato 'tra loke sarveṣāṃ sarvasmācca bhavedbhayam || 7.30.10 ||
translation: सर्वे all, अपि even, जन्तवः living beings, अन्योन्यम् each other, भेतव्ये when there is fear, सति being, बिभ्यति fear, अतः therefore, अत्र here, लोके in the world, सर्वेषाम् for all, सर्वस्मात् from everything, च and, भवेत् may be, भयम् fear.
explanation: All living beings fear each other when there is cause for fear, and thus in this world, everyone may experience fear from everything.

shloka_text: ततो ऽब्रवीन्महातेजा मेघनादं प्रजापतिः । नास्ति सर्वामरत्वं हि कस्यचित्प्राणिनो भुवि । चतुष्पदः पक्षिणश्च भूतानां वा महौजसाम् ।। 7.30.11 ।।
transliteration: tato 'bravīnmahātejā meghanādaṃ prajāpatiḥ | nāsti sarvāmaratvaṃ hi kasyacitprāṇino bhuvi | catuṣpadaḥ pakṣiṇaśca bhūtānāṃ vā mahaujasām || 7.30.11 ||
translation: ततः then, अब्रवीत् spoke, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent, मेघनादम् to Meghanada, प्रजापतिः Prajapati (Brahma), न not, अस्ति is, सर्वामरत्वम् complete immortality, हि indeed, कस्यचित् for anyone, प्राणिनः living being, भुवि on earth, चतुष्पदः four-footed animals, पक्षिणः birds, च and, भूतानाम् of beings, वा or, महौजसाम् of great power.
explanation: Then the greatly effulgent Prajapati Brahma spoke to Meghanada, stating that complete immortality indeed does not exist for any living being on earth, be it four-footed animals, birds, or even beings of great power.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा पितामहेनोक्तमिन्द्रजित्प्रभुणाव्ययम् ।। 7.30.12 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā pitāmahenoktamindrajitprabhuṇāvyayam || 7.30.12 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, पितामहेन by the grandfather (Brahma), उक्तम् spoken, इन्द्रजित् Indrajit (Meghanada), प्रभुणा by the lord, अव्ययम् imperishable (words/truth).
explanation: Having heard the imperishable words spoken by his grandfather, Lord Brahma, Indrajit (Meghanada then responded).

shloka_text: ्वं हि कस्यचित्प्राणिनो भुवि । अथाब्रवीत्स तत्रस्थं मेघनादो महाबलः । श्रूयतां वा भवेत्सिद्धिः शतक्रतुविमोक्षणे ।। 7.30.13 ।।
transliteration: ्vaṃ hi kasyacitprāṇino bhuvi | athābravītsa tatrasthaṃ meghanādo mahābalaḥ | śrūyatāṃ vā bhavetsiddhiḥ śatakratuvimokṣaṇe || 7.30.13 ||
translation: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, सः he, तत्रस्थम् to him who was present there, मेघनादः Meghanada, महाबलः the mighty, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, वा or, भवेत् may there be, सिद्धिः success, शतक्रतुविमोक्षणे in releasing Shakra (Indra).
explanation: Then the mighty Meghanada spoke to Brahma, who was present there, saying, "Let it be heard, or may there be success in releasing Indra."

shloka_text: ममेष्टं नित्यशो हर्व्यैर्मन्त्रैः सम्पूज्य पावकम् । सङ्ग्राममवतर्त्तुं च शत्रुनिर्जयकाङ्क्षिणः ।। 7.30.14 ।।
transliteration: mameṣṭaṃ nityaśo harvyairmantraiḥ sampūjya pāvakam | saṅgrāmamavatarttuṃ ca śatrunirjayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 7.30.14 ||
translation: मम my, इष्टम् desire, नित्यशः always, हर्व्यैः with oblations, मन्त्रैः with mantras, सम्पूज्य having worshipped, पावकम् the fire, सङ्ग्रामम् battle, अवतर्त्तुम् to enter, च and, शत्रुनिर्जयकाङ्क्षिणः desiring victory over enemies.
explanation: My desire is to always worship the fire with oblations and mantras, and then to enter battle, desiring victory over my enemies.

shloka_text: अश्वयुक्तो रथो मह्यमुत्तिष्ठेत्तु विभावसोः । तत्स्थस्यामरता स्यान्मे एष मे निश्चयो वरः ।। 7.30.15 ।।
transliteration: aśvayukto ratho mahyamuttiṣṭhettu vibhāvasoḥ | tatsthasyāmaratā syānme eṣa me niścayo varaḥ || 7.30.15 ||
translation: अश्वयुक्तो horse-yoked, रथो chariot, मह्यम् for me, उत्तिष्ठेत् should rise, तु indeed, विभावसोः of the sun, तत्स्थस्य of one standing on it, अमरता immortality, स्यात् should be, मे for me, एष this, मे my, निश्चयो firm resolve, वरः best.
explanation: My best resolve is that a horse-yoked chariot of the sun should rise for me, and immortality should be granted to one standing on it.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्यद्यसमाप्ते च जप्यहोमे विभावसौ । युध्येयं देव सङ्ग्रामे तदा मे स्याद्विनाशनम् ।। 7.30.16 ।।
transliteration: tasminyadyasamāpte ca japyahome vibhāvasau | yudhyeyaṃ deva saṅgrāme tadā me syādvināśanam || 7.30.16 ||
translation: देव O god, तस्मिन् that, जप्यहोमे rite of muttered prayer and oblation, विभावसौ in the fire, अद्य now, असमाप्ते while unfinished, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, यदि युध्येयम् if I should fight, तदा then, मे my, विनाशनम् destruction, स्यात् would come to be.
explanation: O god, should I ever go to fight in battle while my fire-oblation rite remains unfinished, then in that case my destruction would surely follow.

shloka_text: सर्वो हि तपसा देव वृणोत्यमरतां पुमान् । विक्रमेण मया त्वेतदमरत्वं प्रवर्तितम् ।। 7.30.17 ।।
transliteration: sarvo hi tapasā deva vṛṇotyamaratāṃ pumān | vikrameṇa mayā tvetadamaratvaṃ pravartitam || 7.30.17 ||
translation: सर्वो everyone, हि indeed, तपसा by penance, देव O god, वृणोति obtains, अमरताम् immortality, पुमान् a man, विक्रमेण by valor, मया by me, तु but, एतत् this, अमरत्वम् immortality, प्रवर्तितम् established.
explanation: O god, while every man indeed obtains immortality through penance, I have established this immortality through my valor.

shloka_text: एवमस्त्विति तं चाह वाक्यं देवः पितामहः । मुक्तश्चेन्द्रजिता शक्रो गताश्च त्रिदिवं सुराः ।। 7.30.18 ।।
transliteration: evamastviti taṃ cāha vākyaṃ devaḥ pitāmahaḥ | muktaścendrajitā śakro gatāśca tridivaṃ surāḥ || 7.30.18 ||
translation: एवम् thus, अस्तु let it be, इति thus, तम् to him, च and, आह said, वाक्यम् word, देवः god, पितामहः Brahma, मुक्तः released, च and, इन्द्रजिता by Indrajit, शक्रो Indra, गताः went, च and, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, सुराः gods.
explanation: And thus, the god Brahma said to him, 'So be it,' whereupon Indra was released by Indrajit, and the gods returned to heaven.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम दीनो भ्रष्टाम्बरद्युतिः । इन्द्रश्चिन्तापरीतात्मा ध्यानतत्परतां गतः ।। 7.30.19 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare rāma dīno bhraṣṭāmbaradyutiḥ | indraścintāparītātmā dhyānatatparatāṃ gataḥ || 7.30.19 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, राम O Rama, दीनो distressed, भ्रष्टाम्बरद्युतिः one whose celestial radiance was lost, इन्द्रः Indra, चिन्तापरीतात्मा whose mind was overwhelmed by worry, ध्यानतत्परताम् to the state of being absorbed in thought, गतः attained.
explanation: O Rama, in the meantime, Indra, distressed and having lost his celestial radiance, became absorbed in thought, his mind overwhelmed by worry.

shloka_text: तं तु दृष्ट्वा तथाभूतं प्राह देवः प्रजापतिः । शतक्रतो किमु पुरा करोति स्म सुदुष्कृतम् ।। 7.30.20 ।।
transliteration: taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā tathābhūtaṃ prāha devaḥ prajāpatiḥ | śatakrato kimu purā karoti sma suduṣkṛtam || 7.30.20 ||
translation: तम् him, तु indeed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तथाभूतम् in such a state, प्राह said, देवः god, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, शतक्रतो O Shatakratu, किमु what indeed, पुरा formerly, करोति did, स्म (past tense marker), सुदुष्कृतम् a very evil deed.
explanation: Indeed, having seen him in such a state, the god Prajapati (Brahma) asked, 'O Shatakratu, what great evil deed did you commit formerly?'

shloka_text: अमरेन्द्र मया बह्व्यः प्रजाः सृष्टास्तथा प्रभो । एकवर्णाः समाभाषा एकरूपाश्च सर्वशः ।। 7.30.21 ।।
transliteration: amarendra mayā bahvyaḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭāstathā prabho | ekavarṇāḥ samābhāṣā ekarūpāśca sarvaśaḥ || 7.30.21 ||
translation: अमरेन्द्र O king of immortals, मया by me, बह्व्यः many, प्रजाः creatures, सृष्टाः were created, तथा thus, प्रभो O lord, एकवर्णाः of one color, समाभाषाः speaking the same language, एकरूपाः of one form, च and, सर्वशः in every respect.
explanation: O Lord Indra, I created many beings who were all of the same color, spoke the same language, and had the same form in every respect.

shloka_text: तासां नास्ति विशेषो हि दर्शने लक्षणे ऽपि वा । ततो ऽहमेकाग्रमनास्ताः प्रजाः परिचिन्तयम् ।। 7.30.22 ।।
transliteration: tāsāṃ nāsti viśeṣo hi darśane lakṣaṇe 'pi vā | tato 'hamekāgramanāstāḥ prajāḥ paricintayam || 7.30.22 ||
translation: तासां among them, न not, अस्ति there is, विशेषः distinction, हि indeed, दर्शने in appearance, लक्षणे in characteristics, अपि even, वा or, ततः then, अहम् I, एकाग्रमनाः with a concentrated mind, ताः those, प्रजाः creatures, परिचिन्तयम् pondered.
explanation: Indeed, there was no distinction among them in appearance or even in characteristics, so I pondered deeply about those creatures with a concentrated mind.

shloka_text: सो ऽहं तासां विशेषार्थं स्त्रियमेकां विनिर्ममे । यद्यत्प्रजानां प्रत्यङ्गं विशिष्टं तत्तदुद्धृतम् ।। 7.30.23 ।।
transliteration: so 'haṃ tāsāṃ viśeṣārthaṃ striyamekāṃ vinirmame | yadyatprajānāṃ pratyaṅgaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ tattaduddhṛtam || 7.30.23 ||
translation: सः that, अहम् I, तासां among them, विशेषार्थं for the sake of distinction, स्त्रियम् a woman, एकां one, विनिर्ममे created, यद्यत् whatever, प्रजानां of the creatures, प्रत्यङ्गं each limb, विशिष्टं excellent, तत् तत् that that, उद्धृतम् was taken out.
explanation: Therefore, I created one woman for the sake of distinction among them, extracting whatever was excellent from each limb of the creatures.

shloka_text: ततो मया रूपगुणैरहल्या स्त्री विनिर्मिता । हलं नामेह वैरूपं हल्यं तत्प्रभवं भवेत् ।। 7.30.24 ।।
transliteration: tato mayā rūpaguṇairahalyā strī vinirmitā | halaṃ nāmeha vairūpaṃ halyaṃ tatprabhavaṃ bhavet || 7.30.24 ||
translation: ततः then, मया by me, रूपगुणैः with qualities of beauty, अहल्या Ahalya, स्त्री a woman, विनिर्मिता was created, हलं Hala, नाम indeed, इह here, वैरूपं ugliness, हल्यं that which is born from Hala, तत्प्रभवं born from that, भवेत् is.
explanation: Then, I created a woman named Ahalya, endowed with qualities of beauty, for "Hala" here means ugliness or deformity, and "Halya" is that which arises from it.

shloka_text: यस्मान्न विद्यते हल्यं तेनाहल्येति विश्रुता । अहल्येति मया शक्र तस्या नाम प्रवर्तितम् ।। 7.30.25 ।।
transliteration: yasmānna vidyate halyaṃ tenāhalyeti viśrutā | ahalyeti mayā śakra tasyā nāma pravartitam || 7.30.25 ||
translation: यस्मात् because, न not, विद्यते exists, हल्यं ugliness, तेन therefore, अहल्येति as Ahalya, विश्रुता renowned, अहल्येति as Ahalya, मया by me, शक्र O Shakra, तस्याः her, नाम name, प्रवर्तितम् was given.
explanation: Because no ugliness exists in her, she is renowned as Ahalya, and O Shakra, I thus established her name as Ahalya.

shloka_text: निर्मितायां च देवेन्द्र तस्यां नार्यां सुरर्षभ । भविष्यतीति कस्यैषा मम चिन्ता ततो ऽभवत् ।। 7.30.26 ।।
transliteration: nirmitāyāṃ ca devendra tasyāṃ nāryāṃ surarṣabha | bhaviṣyatīti kasyaiṣā mama cintā tato 'bhavat || 7.30.26 ||
translation: निर्मितायां when created, च and, देवेन्द्र O king of gods, तस्यां in that, नार्यां woman, सुरर्षभ O best of gods, भविष्यतीति will be, कस्यैषा whose is this, मम my, चिन्ता worry, ततो then, अभवत् arose,
explanation: O Indra, O best of gods, when that woman was created, a worry arose in me, thinking, "Whose will she be?"

shloka_text: त्वं तु शक्र तदा नारीं जानीषे मनसा प्रभो । स्थानाधिकतया पत्नी ममैषेति पुरन्दर ।। 7.30.27 ।।
transliteration: tvaṃ tu śakra tadā nārīṃ jānīṣe manasā prabho | sthānādhikatayā patnī mamaiṣeti purandara || 7.30.27 ||
translation: त्वं you, तु indeed, शक्र O Shakra, तदा then, नारीं woman, जानीषे knew, मनसा mentally, प्रभो O lord, स्थानाधिकतया due to superiority of position, पत्नी wife, ममैषेति mine is this, पुरन्दर O Purandara,
explanation: O Shakra, O Lord, O Purandara, you then mentally considered that woman to be your wife due to your superior position.

shloka_text: सा मया न्यासभूता तु गौतमस्य महात्मनः । न्यस्ता बहूनि वर्षाणि तेन निर्यातिता च ह ।। 7.30.28 ।।
transliteration: sā mayā nyāsabhūtā tu gautamasya mahātmanaḥ | nyastā bahūni varṣāṇi tena niryātitā ca ha || 7.30.28 ||
translation: सा she, मया by me, न्यासभूता as a deposit, तु but, गौतमस्य of Gautama, महात्मनः the great-souled, न्यस्ता entrusted, बहूनि many, वर्षाणि years, तेन by him, निर्यातिता returned, च and, ह indeed,
explanation: But she was entrusted by me as a deposit to the great-souled Gautama for many years, and indeed, she was returned by him.

shloka_text: ततस्तस्य परिज्ञाय महास्थैर्यं महामुनेः । ज्ञात्वा तपसि सिद्धिं च पत्न्यर्थं स्पर्शिता तदा ।। 7.30.29 ।।
transliteration: tatastasya parijñāya mahāsthairyaṃ mahāmuneḥ | jñātvā tapasi siddhiṃ ca patnyarthaṃ sparśitā tadā || 7.30.29 ||
translation: ततस्तस्य then his, परिज्ञाय having known, महास्थैर्यं great steadfastness, महामुनेः of the great sage, ज्ञात्वा having known, तपसि in penance, सिद्धिं success, च and, पत्न्यर्थं for the purpose of a wife, स्पर्शिता offered, तदा then,
explanation: Then, having understood the great steadfastness of that great sage and his success in penance, she was offered to him as a wife.

shloka_text: सङ्क्रुद्धस्त्वं हि धर्मात्मन् गत्वा तस्याश्रमं मुनेः । दृष्टवांश्च तदा तां स्त्रीं दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव ।। 7.30.30 ।।
transliteration: saṅkruddhastvaṃ hi dharmātman gatvā tasyāśramaṃ muneḥ | dṛṣṭavāṃśca tadā tāṃ strīṃ dīptāmagniśikhāmiva || 7.30.30 ||
translation: सङ्क्रुद्धस्त्वं you, being very angry, हि indeed, धर्मात्मन् O righteous one, गत्वा having gone, तस्याश्रमं to his hermitage, मुनेः of the sage, दृष्टवांश्च and you saw, तदा then, तां that, स्त्रीं woman, दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव shining like a flame of fire,
explanation: Indeed, you, being very angry, O righteous one, went to that sage's hermitage and then saw that woman shining like a flame of fire.

shloka_text: सा त्वया धर्षिता शक्र कामार्तेन समन्युना । दृष्टस्त्वं च तदा तेन ह्याश्रमे परमर्षिणा ।। 7.30.31 ।।
transliteration: sā tvayā dharṣitā śakra kāmārtena samanyunā | dṛṣṭastvaṃ ca tadā tena hyāśrame paramarṣiṇā || 7.30.31 ||
translation: सा She, त्वया by you, धर्षिता was violated, शक्र O Shakra, कामार्तेन afflicted by lust, समन्युना with anger, दृष्टः seen, त्वं you, च and, तदा then, तेन by him, हि indeed, आश्रमे in the hermitage, परमर्षिणा by the great sage.
explanation: O Shakra, she was violated by you, who were afflicted by lust and anger, and you were then indeed seen in the hermitage by the great sage.

shloka_text: ततः क्रुद्धेन तेना ऽसि शप्तः परमतेजसा । गतो ऽसि येन देवेन्द्र दशाभागविपर्ययम् ।। 7.30.32 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kruddhena tenā 'si śaptaḥ paramatejasā | gato 'si yena devendra daśābhāgaviparyayam || 7.30.32 ||
translation: ततः Then, क्रुद्धेन by the enraged, तेन by him, असि you were, शप्तः cursed, परमतेजसा of great ascetic power, गतः gone, असि you are, येन by which, देवेन्द्र O king of gods, दशाभागविपर्ययम् a reversal of your state.
explanation: Then, by that enraged sage of great ascetic power, you were cursed, O king of gods, by which you have undergone a reversal of your state.

shloka_text: यस्मान्मे धर्षिता पत्नी त्वया वासव निर्भयम् । तस्मात्त्वं समरे राजञ्छत्रुहस्तं गमिष्यसि ।। 7.30.33 ।।
transliteration: yasmānme dharṣitā patnī tvayā vāsava nirbhayam | tasmāttvaṃ samare rājañchatruhastaṃ gamiṣyasi || 7.30.33 ||
translation: यस्मात् Because, मे my, धर्षिता was violated, पत्नी wife, त्वया by you, वासव O Vasava, निर्भयम् fearlessly, तस्मात् therefore, त्वं you, समरे in battle, राजन् O king, शत्रुहस्तं into the hands of enemies, गमिष्यसि will go.
explanation: Because my wife was fearlessly violated by you, O Vasava, therefore, O king, you will fall into the hands of your enemies in battle.

shloka_text: अयं तु भावो दुर्बुद्धे यस्त्वयेह प्रवर्तितः । मानुषेष्वपि लोकेषु भविष्यति न संशयः ।। 7.30.34 ।।
transliteration: ayaṃ tu bhāvo durbuddhe yastvayeha pravartitaḥ | mānuṣeṣvapi lokeṣu bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 7.30.34 ||
translation: अयं This, तु but, भावः state/consequence, दुर्बुद्धे O evil-minded one, यः which, त्वया by you, इह here, प्रवर्तितः initiated, मानुषेषु among humans, अपि even, लोकेषु in worlds, भविष्यति will be, न no, संशयः doubt.
explanation: But this consequence, O evil-minded one, which you have initiated here, will undoubtedly also manifest in the human worlds.

shloka_text: तत्रार्धं तस्य यः कर्ता त्वय्यर्धं निपतिष्यति । न च ते स्थावरं स्थानं भविष्यति न संशयः ।। 7.30.35 ।।
transliteration: tatrārdhaṃ tasya yaḥ kartā tvayyardhaṃ nipatiṣyati | na ca te sthāvaraṃ sthānaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 7.30.35 ||
translation: तत्र There, अर्धं half, तस्य of that, यः who, कर्ता doer, त्वयि on you, अर्धं half, निपतिष्यति will fall, न not, च and, ते for you, स्थावरं fixed, स्थानं place, भविष्यति will be, न no, संशयः doubt.
explanation: In that matter, half of the consequence will fall upon the doer, and half upon you, and undoubtedly, you will not have a fixed abode.

shloka_text: यश्च यश्च सुरेन्द्रः स्याद्ध्रुवः स न भविष्यति । एष शापो मया मुक्त इत्यसौ त्वां तदा ऽब्रवीत् ।। 7.30.36 ।।
transliteration: yaśca yaśca surendraḥ syāddhruvaḥ sa na bhaviṣyati | eṣa śāpo mayā mukta ityasau tvāṃ tadā 'bravīt || 7.30.36 ||
translation: यश्च यश्च whoever, whoever, सुरेन्द्रः king of gods, स्यात् may be, ध्रुवः permanent, स he, न not, भविष्यति will be, एषः this, शापः curse, मया by me, मुक्तः uttered, इति thus, असौ he, त्वाम् to you, तदा then, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: The sage then told you that whoever becomes the king of gods will not remain permanent, as this curse has been uttered by him.

shloka_text: तां तु भार्यां स निर्भर्त्स्य सो ऽब्रवीत्सुमहातपाः । दुर्विनीते विनिध्वंस ममाश्रमसमीपतः ।। 7.30.37 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ tu bhāryāṃ sa nirbhartsya so 'bravītsumahātapāḥ | durvinīte vinidhvaṃsa mamāśramasamīpataḥ || 7.30.37 ||
translation: ताम् her, तु indeed, भार्याम् wife, सः he, निर्भर्त्स्य having rebuked, सः he, अब्रवीत् said, सुमहातपाः the great ascetic, दुर्विनीते O ill-behaved one, विनिध्वंस perish, मम my, आश्रमसमीपतः from the vicinity of the hermitage.
explanation: Having rebuked his wife, the great ascetic then said, "O ill-behaved one, disappear from the vicinity of my hermitage!"

shloka_text: रूपयौवनसम्पन्ना यस्मात्त्वमनवस्थिता । तस्माद्रूपवती लोके न त्वमेका भविष्यति ।। 7.30.38 ।।
transliteration: rūpayauvanasampannā yasmāttvamanavasthitā | tasmādrūpavatī loke na tvamekā bhaviṣyati || 7.30.38 ||
translation: रूपयौवनसम्पन्ना endowed with beauty and youth, यस्मात् because, त्वम् you, अनवस्थिता are unstable, तस्मात् therefore, रूपवती beautiful woman, लोके in the world, न not, त्वम् you, एका alone, भविष्यति will be.
explanation: Because you, endowed with beauty and youth, are unstable, therefore you will not be the only beautiful woman in the world.

shloka_text: रूपं च ते प्रजाः सर्वा गमिष्यन्ति न संशयः । यत्तदेकं समाश्रित्य विभ्रमो ऽयमुपस्थितः ।। 7.30.39 ।।
transliteration: rūpaṃ ca te prajāḥ sarvā gamiṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ | yattadekaṃ samāśritya vibhramo 'yamupasthitaḥ || 7.30.39 ||
translation: रूपम् beauty, च and, ते your, प्रजाः creatures, सर्वाः all, गमिष्यन्ति will obtain, न not, संशयः doubt, यत् which, तत् that, एकम् unique, समाश्रित्य having relied upon, विभ्रमः delusion, अयम् this, उपस्थितः has arisen.
explanation: All creatures will undoubtedly obtain your beauty, having relied upon which unique beauty this delusion has arisen.

shloka_text: तदाप्रभृति भूयिष्ठं प्रजा रूपसमन्विताः । सा तं प्रसादयामास महर्षिं गौतमं तदा ।। 7.30.40 ।।
transliteration: tadāprabhṛti bhūyiṣṭhaṃ prajā rūpasamanvitāḥ | sā taṃ prasādayāmāsa maharṣiṃ gautamaṃ tadā || 7.30.40 ||
translation: तदाप्रभृति from that time onwards, भूयिष्ठम् mostly, प्रजाः creatures, रूपसमन्विताः endowed with beauty, सा she, तम् him, प्रसादयामास propitiated, महर्षिम् the great sage, गौतमम् Gautama, तदा then.
explanation: From that time onwards, most creatures became endowed with beauty, and then she (Ahalya) propitiated the great sage Gautama.

shloka_text: अज्ञानाद्धर्षिता विप्र त्वद्रूपेण दिवौकसा । न कामकाराद्विप्रर्षे प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ।। 7.30.41 ।।
transliteration: ajñānāddharṣitā vipra tvadrūpeṇa divaukasā | na kāmakārādviprarṣe prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 7.30.41 ||
translation: अज्ञानात् due to ignorance, हर्षिता deceived, विप्र O Brahmana, त्वद्रूपेण in your guise, दिवौकसा by the celestial being (Indra), न not, कामकारात् willingly, विप्रर्षे O Brahmana-sage, प्रसादम् grace, कर्तुम् to grant, अर्हसि you ought.
explanation: O Brahmana-sage, I was deceived by the celestial being in your guise due to ignorance, not willingly, so you ought to grant me your grace.

shloka_text: अहल्यया त्वेवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच स गौतमः । उत्पत्स्यति महातेजा इक्ष्वाकूणां महारथः ।। 7.30.42 ।।
transliteration: ahalyayā tvevamuktaḥ pratyuvāca sa gautamaḥ | utpatsyati mahātejā ikṣvākūṇāṃ mahārathaḥ || 7.30.42 ||
translation: अहल्यया by Ahalya, तु indeed, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, प्रत्युवाच replied, सः he, गौतमः Gautama, उत्पत्स्यति will be born, महातेजाः greatly effulgent, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of the Ikshvakus, महारथः a great warrior.
explanation: Thus addressed by Ahalya, Gautama replied that a greatly effulgent and great warrior of the Ikshvaku dynasty would be born.

shloka_text: रामो नाम श्रुतो लोके वनं चाप्युपयास्यति । ब्राह्मणार्थे महाबाहुर्विष्णुर्मानुषविग्रहः । तं द्रक्ष्यसि यदा भद्रे ततः पूता भविष्यसि ।। 7.30.43 ।।
transliteration: rāmo nāma śruto loke vanaṃ cāpyupayāsyati | brāhmaṇārthe mahābāhurviṣṇurmānuṣavigrahaḥ | taṃ drakṣyasi yadā bhadre tataḥ pūtā bhaviṣyasi || 7.30.43 ||
translation: रामः Rama, नाम by name, श्रुतः known, लोके in the world, वनम् forest, च and, अपि also, उपयास्यति will come, ब्राह्मणार्थे for the sake of Brahmanas, महाबाहुः mighty-armed, विष्णुः Vishnu, मानुषविग्रहः in human form, तम् him, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see, यदा when, भद्रे O auspicious one, ततः then, पूता purified, भविष्यसि you will become.
explanation: He will be known as Rama in the world, will come to the forest for the sake of Brahmanas, being the mighty-armed Vishnu in human form; when you see him, O auspicious one, you will then become purified.

shloka_text: स हि पावयितुं शक्तस्त्वया यद्दुष्कृतं कृतम् । तस्यातिथ्यं च कृत्वा वै मत्समीपं गमिष्यसि ।। 7.30.44 ।।
transliteration: sa hi pāvayituṃ śaktastvayā yadduṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam | tasyātithyaṃ ca kṛtvā vai matsamīpaṃ gamiṣyasi || 7.30.44 ||
translation: सः he, हि indeed, पावयितुम् to purify, शक्तः capable, त्वया by you, यत् whatever, दुष्कृतम् evil deed, कृतम् done, तस्य his, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, च and, कृत्वा having done, वै indeed, मत्समीपम् to my proximity, गमिष्यसि you will go.
explanation: He is indeed capable of purifying whatever evil deed you have committed, and after offering him hospitality, you will return to my side.

shloka_text: वत्स्यसि त्वं मया सार्धं तदा हि वरवर्णिनि । एवमुक्त्वा स विप्रर्षिराजगाम स्वमाश्रमम् ।। 7.30.45 ।।
transliteration: vatsyasi tvaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ tadā hi varavarṇini | evamuktvā sa viprarṣirājagāma svamāśramam || 7.30.45 ||
translation: वत्स्यसि you will dwell, त्वम् you, मया with me, सार्धम् together, तदा then, हि indeed, वरवर्णिनि O beautiful lady, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, सः he, विप्रर्षिः the Brahmana-sage, आजगाम went, स्वम् his own, आश्रमम् hermitage.
explanation: Then, O beautiful lady, you will indeed dwell with me; having spoken thus, the Brahmana-sage returned to his own hermitage.

shloka_text: तपश्चाचार सुमहत्सा पत्नी ब्रह्मवादिनः । शापोत्सर्गाद्धि तस्येदं मुनेः सर्वमुपस्थितम् ।। 7.30.46 ।।
transliteration: tapaścācāra sumahatsā patnī brahmavādinaḥ | śāpotsargāddhi tasyedaṃ muneḥ sarvamupasthitam || 7.30.46 ||
translation: तपः penance, च and, आचार performed, सुमहत् very great, सा she, पत्नी wife, ब्रह्मवादिनः of the knower of Brahman, शापोत्सर्गात् from the utterance of the curse, हि indeed, तस्य of that, इदम् this, मुनेः of the sage, सर्वम् all, उपस्थितम् has come to pass.
explanation: Indeed, that wife of the knower of Brahman performed very great penance, and all this has come to pass from the utterance of the sage's curse.

shloka_text: तत्स्मर त्वं महाबाहो दुष्कृतं यत्त्वया कृतम् । तेन त्वं ग्रहणं शत्रोर्यातो नान्येन वासव ।। 7.30.47 ।।
transliteration: tatsmara tvaṃ mahābāho duṣkṛtaṃ yattvayā kṛtam | tena tvaṃ grahaṇaṃ śatroryāto nānyena vāsava || 7.30.47 ||
translation: तत् that, स्मर remember, त्वम् you, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, दुष्कृतम् evil deed, यत् which, त्वया by you, कृतम् was done, तेन by that, त्वम् you, ग्रहणम् capture, शत्रोः by the enemy, यातः have obtained, न not, अन्येन by another, वासव O Vasava.
explanation: O mighty-armed Vasava, remember that evil deed which you committed; by that alone have you been captured by the enemy, and not by any other means.

shloka_text: शीघ्रं वै यज यज्ञं त्वं वैष्णवं सुसमाहितः । पावितस्तेन यज्ञेन यास्यसे त्रिदिवं ततः ।। 7.30.48 ।।
transliteration: śīghraṃ vai yaja yajñaṃ tvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ susamāhitaḥ | pāvitastena yajñena yāsyase tridivaṃ tataḥ || 7.30.48 ||
translation: शीघ्रम् quickly, वै indeed, यज perform, यज्ञम् sacrifice, त्वम् you, वैष्णवम् related to Vishnu, सुसमाहितः with great concentration, पावितः purified, तेन by that, यज्ञेन by the sacrifice, यास्यसे you will go, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, ततः thereafter.
explanation: You must quickly perform a Vaishnava sacrifice with great concentration, and purified by that sacrifice, you will then ascend to heaven.

shloka_text: पुत्रश्च तव देवेन्द्र न विनष्टो महारणे । नीतः सन्निहितश्चैव आर्यकेण महोदधौ ।। 7.30.49 ।।
transliteration: putraśca tava devendra na vinaṣṭo mahāraṇe | nītaḥ sannihitaścaiva āryakeṇa mahodadhau || 7.30.49 ||
translation: पुत्रः son, च and, तव your, देवेन्द्र O king of gods, न not, विनष्टः perished, महारणे in the great battle, नीतः taken, सन्निहितः kept, च and, एव indeed, आर्यकेण by Aryaka, महोदधौ in the great ocean.
explanation: O king of gods, your son did not perish in the great battle; he was taken and kept safe by Aryaka in the great ocean.

shloka_text: एतच्छ्रुत्वा महेन्द्रस्तु यज्ञमिष्ट्वा च वैष्णवम् । पुनस्त्रिदिवमाक्रामदन्वशासच्च देवराट् ।। 7.30.50 ।।
transliteration: etacchrutvā mahendrastu yajñamiṣṭvā ca vaiṣṇavam | punastridivamākrāmadanvaśāsacca devarāṭ || 7.30.50 ||
translation: एतत् this, श्रुत्वा having heard, महेन्द्रः Mahendra, तु and, यज्ञम् sacrifice, इष्ट्वा having performed, च and, वैष्णवम् related to Vishnu, पुनः again, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, आक्रामत् ascended, अन्वशासत् ruled, च and, देवराट् the king of gods.
explanation: Having heard this, Mahendra performed the Vaishnava sacrifice, and the king of gods then ascended to heaven again and ruled.

shloka_text: एतदिन्द्रजितो नाम बलं यत्कीर्तितं मया । निर्जितस्तेन देवेन्द्रः प्राणिनो ऽन्ये तु किं पुनः ।। 7.30.51 ।।
transliteration: etadindrajito nāma balaṃ yatkīrtitaṃ mayā | nirjitastena devendraḥ prāṇino 'nye tu kiṃ punaḥ || 7.30.51 ||
translation: एतत् this, इन्द्रजितः of Indrajit, नाम indeed, बलं strength, यत् which, कीर्तितम् has been recounted, मया by me, निर्जितः conquered, तेन by him, देवेन्द्रः the lord of gods, प्राणिनः living beings, अन्ये others, तु but, किं what, पुनः moreover.
explanation: This is the power of Indrajit that I have recounted, by which even the lord of gods, Indra, was conquered; what then to speak of other living beings?

shloka_text: आश्चर्यमिति रामश्च लक्ष्मणश्चाब्रवीत्तदा । अगस्त्यवचनं श्रुत्वा वानरा राक्षसास्तदा ।। 7.30.52 ।।
transliteration: āścaryamiti rāmaśca lakṣmaṇaścābravīttadā | agastyavacanaṃ śrutvā vānarā rākṣasāstadā || 7.30.52 ||
translation: आश्चर्यम् wonderful, इति thus, रामः Rama, च and, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, च and, अब्रवीत् said, तदा then, अगस्त्यवचनम् the words of Agastya, श्रुत्वा having heard, वानराः monkeys, राक्षसाः demons, तदा then.
explanation: Then, having heard the words of Agastya, Rama and Lakshmana, along with the monkeys and demons, exclaimed, "Wonderful!"

shloka_text: विभीषणस्तु रामस्य पार्श्वस्थो वाक्यमब्रवीत् । आश्चर्यं स्मारितो ऽस्म्यद्य यत्तद्दृष्टं पुरातनम् ।। 7.30.53 ।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇastu rāmasya pārśvastho vākyamabravīt | āścaryaṃ smārito 'smyadya yattaddṛṣṭaṃ purātanam || 7.30.53 ||
translation: विभीषणः Vibhishana, तु but, रामस्य of Rama, पार्श्वस्थः standing by the side, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said, आश्चर्यम् a wonder, स्मारितः reminded, अस्मि I am, अद्य today, यत् which, तत् that, दृष्टम् seen, पुरातनम् ancient.
explanation: But Vibhishana, standing by Rama's side, spoke, saying, "I am reminded today of that ancient wonder which I had seen."

shloka_text: अगस्त्यं त्वब्रवीद्रामः सत्यमेतच्छ्रुतं च मे ।। 7.30.54 ।।
transliteration: agastyaṃ tvabravīdrāmaḥ satyametacchrutaṃ ca me || 7.30.54 ||
translation: अगस्त्यम् to Agastya, तु but, अब्रवीत् said, रामः Rama, सत्यम् true, एतत् this, श्रुतम् heard, च and, मे by me.
explanation: But Rama said to Agastya, "This is true, and I have also heard it."

shloka_text: एवं राम समुद्भूतो रावणो लोककण्टकः । सपुत्रो येन सङ्ग्रामे जितः शक्रः सुरेश्वरः ।। 7.30.55 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ rāma samudbhūto rāvaṇo lokakaṇṭakaḥ | saputro yena saṅgrāme jitaḥ śakraḥ sureśvaraḥ || 7.30.55 ||
translation: एवम् thus, राम O Rama, समुद्भूतः originated, रावणः Ravana, लोककण्टकः a tormentor of the world, सपुत्रः with his son, येन by whom, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, जितः conquered, शक्रः Shakra, सुरेश्वरः the lord of gods.
explanation: O Rama, thus was born Ravana, a tormentor of the world, by whom, along with his son, Shakra, the lord of gods, was conquered in battle. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 30 ।। Thus ends the thirtieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
